zh: 真的去翻转整个字符串每次要 O(n)，太慢。注意一次全串翻转后，某个前缀里 0 的个数就变成“前缀长度 − 原来 0 的个数”。
连续翻转两次等于没翻，所以只需记录翻转次数的奇偶。预先算出初始串的 0 前缀和，查询时根据当前是否处于翻转状态，选择原前缀 0 数或前缀长度减去它。
建立 zero[i+1] = 前 i+1 个字符中 0 的个数；flip 只切换一个布尔标记；count i 时令 z = zero[i+1]，未翻转输出 z，已翻转输出 (i+1) − z。所有答案按顺序空格分隔输出在一行，没有查询时输出空行。
en: Actually flipping the whole string costs O(n) each time, which is too slow. Notice that after one full flip, the number of 0s in a prefix becomes the prefix length minus the original number of 0s.

Flipping twice is the same as not flipping, so only the parity of the number of flips matters. Precompute prefix counts of 0s in the initial string, and for a query choose either the original count or the prefix length minus it, depending on the current state.

Build zero[i+1] = number of 0s among the first i+1 characters; flip just toggles a boolean; for count i let z = zero[i+1] and print z if not flipped, or (i+1) - z if flipped. Print all answers in order on one line separated by spaces, or an empty line if there are no queries.

explanationEn:
## Approach

First compute prefix sums of 0s in the initial string. Flipping the whole string only toggles one boolean state; when querying position i, the answer is the original prefix count of 0s if unflipped, or (i+1) minus the original prefix count of 0s if flipped.

## Proof of correctness

The initial prefix sums record exactly the number of 0s up to each position. A full flip swaps every 0 and 1 within the prefix, so the number of 0s becomes the prefix length minus the original count. Multiple flips depend only on the parity of the number of flips; outputting each operation by this rule is exactly equivalent to actually modifying the whole string and counting again.

## Complexity

O(n+q) time and O(n) space.
